# release version

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:releaseVersion`](gmeow-releaseVersion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/releaseVersion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The version designation of a release — e.g. 'v1.0.0', '2.1.0-beta.3'. Not functional: competing version schemes may coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
